org.monflabs.nashorn:nashorn-node 2026.0.0 发布, EXPERIMENTAL, INCOMPLETE. A Node-compatibility module resolver, provided as
    a convenience and as a worked example of building built-in modules on the
    engine. Answers a handful of Node's built-in specifiers - fs, buffer, os,
    path - from bare or node: imports, in pure Java. It reaches into the
    engine's internal object model (core exports those packages to this module
    by name), so a given nashorn-node is a companion to the exact same version of
    nashorn-core; do not mix versions.

ai.mattmann.mnemosyne:cas-metadata 1.13.2 发布, A Multi-valued, generic Metadata container class. The class uses an internal
	Map of string keys pointing to vectors of strings. The data
	structure looks like the following:

	[std:string key]⇒std:vector of std:strings

	The multi-valued nature of the class is handled transparently by this Metadata
	container. Since all values are stored internally as string vectors, the difference
	between a scalar value and a non-scalar is handled by determining whether the list of
	values for a particular key is greater than 1.

items.title: ai.bithuman:essence2-android 0.5.10 发布, Android AAR for the bitHuman essence-2 avatar engine: drives an avatar bundle and composes teeth BORROWED from the donor bank rather than synthesizing them. A self-hosted session is metered at the published self-hosted rate (https://docs.bithuman.ai/guides/pricing); a credential the service rejects keeps rendering for a five-minute grace, then the session refuses, while a service that cannot be reached never stops a render. Bundles the engine's native library plus libonnxruntime.so and libc++_shared.so for arm64-v8a.

        drop-in plugin bundles (PLAT-12). A thin, zero-additional-dependency validator: it
        depends only on ravenroot-application-api, reusing PayloadJson/PayloadValue/PayloadLimits
        for manifest parsing rather than adding a YAML or JSON Schema library. Deliberately does
        not depend on ravenroot-core: this module never loads a class, never touches
        NodePackage/NodePackages, and is callable standalone by plugin.sh (build/validate/install)
        without pulling in the runtime.

items.title:
ai.ravenroot:ravenroot-observability-otel 0.4.1-alpha.1 发布, PLAT-01: the OpenTelemetry export bridge, spans, metrics and
        log-correlation identifiers derived from ai.ravenroot.api.application.ExecutionEvent, the
        same event ai.ravenroot.server.audit.StructuredExecutionLogger already consumes. Depends on
        ravenroot-application-api (the event shape) and ravenroot-core (ExecutionMonitor.subscribe,
        the only extension point this module uses) and nothing else in the ai.ravenroot tree. Neither
        of those two modules, nor ravenroot-application-api's other consumers, every third-party
        node package, depends on this one: the OpenTelemetry SDK is reachable from exactly one kind
        of caller, a composition root (RavenrootServerMain, RavenrootCliMain), which is what makes
        "no OpenTelemetry dependency in core" a property the compiler enforces rather than prose.
        Disabled unless RAVENROOT_OTEL_ENABLED is set; see
        TelemetryConfiguration. Every OpenTelemetry artifact here is Apache License 2.0; this module
        has not been through the release SBOM and licence scan and should be before it
        ships in a tagged release.
